scope: TASK-537 pre-integration source readiness: configuration, all-ancestor admission, cancellation, budgets, preview, receipts, public manifest and canonical guidance
code_manifest_definition: SHA-256 of compact sort_keys JSON array sorted by path, each entry {path,sha256(blob)}. Paths are changed implementation files between target and reviewed commit, excluding tasks/, ROADMAP.md and docs/ci-child-composition-evidence.md.
method: Independent static reviews plus direct inspection of actual old/new CLI outputs, persisted receipts, OCI intents and full CI evidence. All 34 implementation files independently matched committed blobs, with zero mismatches. The reviewer did not rerun tests.

ci.limitation: The full receipt attests the dirty precommit input, not the final commit itself. Independent manifest-to-commit equality and separate documentation/board verification cover subsequent record-only changes.

binary.mixed_versions: Both directions reject live nested CI; old binary rejects child_ci; old receipt reader reads the two new successful fixture receipts.
binary.native_composition: New parent/child succeed with linked receipts and unchanged available Git attestations.
binary.ordinary_oci_leaf: Success and parent SIGTERM cancellation have identity-matched exact-CID cleanup and successful absence proof, without cleanup errors.

limits: This is source readiness, not proof of completed source integration/push/reclaim, installed-binary update, consumer predeploy, public release or deployment. Native hard containment, malicious detached work and OCI-internal child composition are excluded.
